# Backlog

**Status:** living · project-owned. The parking lot for ideas, wishes, deferred work and migrations —
anything that is not yet a phase or unit in `docs/ROADMAP.md`. Nothing here is a commitment.

**Who adds:** anyone — the maintainer, a planning session, an implementer's "out of scope noticed"
in a PR, a reviewer. One line per item, dated. **Who promotes:** the weekly outer loop: an item
becomes a unit in a roadmap phase, stays here with a new note, or is rejected with the reason
(rejected items stay listed, struck through, so the same idea is not re-argued from scratch).

Item states: `idea` · `someday` (agreed, unscheduled) · `waiting on <who/what>` · `→ P<n>` (promoted;
tracked in the roadmap from then on) · ~~rejected — reason~~.
